items.title: Introducing Agent-Native Beta: The Framework for Agentic Apps
items.excerpt: Builder.io released Agent-Native, an open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents with rich UIs: define an action once and use it in the UI, the agent, the API, the CLI and MCP.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon is rolling out in Figma Make
items.excerpt: Figma's release notes say Google's Gemini 4 Argon model is rolling out as a model option in Figma Make, its prompt-to-app tool.

items.title: AI is hollowing out the middle of design, leaving an hourglass behind
items.excerpt: For fifteen years the design process kept growing while the time left for making the product kept shrinking; the essay argues AI is now compressing the middle of that process into an hourglass shape.

items.title: The synth everyone owned and few could program: a lesson for AI design
items.excerpt: Using the Yamaha DX7 and its factory presets as a parable, the piece argues AI made design quality available to everyone and average, so what sets work apart now is a visible decision.

items.title: Secret agent bot: accessibility matters for the agents even if you can't see them
items.excerpt: The semantic structure screen readers rely on now also decides whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity agents can read a page at all; the agent never sees the designed surface, only the structure underneath. (Note: overlaps the recently published 'accessibility tree as agent UX' story.)

items.title: I tried those free AI-coded Adobe Creative Cloud clones, and they have some big problems
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq tested ArtCraft and other free, AI-coded clones of Photoshop and Premiere and found they are not ready to replace Adobe's apps yet.

items.title: This game was made with AI in 30 minutes, and it's a bit of a wake-up call
items.excerpt: Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii built a playable game with AI in 30 minutes, an experiment that makes game development look ridiculously easy and raises questions for game artists and designers.

items.title: Epic's delayed Marvel and Star Wars game is going all-in on AI
items.excerpt: Epic says its delayed Disney game will lean heavily on AI-generated content, and fans and creatives are not buying its promise of 'MORE and BETTER stuff'.

items.title: Epic thinks you'll love its new vibe coded game launcher
items.excerpt: Epic is touting a new game launcher built with vibe coding, and Engadget argues that laying off workers for AI is nothing to celebrate.

items.title: Chatbots Are Lazy Design: Building an 'Invisible UI' with In-Browser SLMs & WebGPU
items.excerpt: An 18-minute deep dive arguing chat boxes are lazy AI UX, and showing how to build an 'invisible UI' driven by small language models running in the browser on WebGPU.

items.title: Keep the Composition Stable Across Sketch, Pencil and Generated Film
items.excerpt: A workflow note on keeping composition consistent as a piece moves from sketch to pencil to an AI-generated, film-like image, because the drawing and the generated frame must describe the same structure.

items.title: Spectral Labs builds 'Turing Test for AI CAD'
items.excerpt: Spectral Labs claims to have built the first AI system to pass an industry-standard CAD certification for mechanical engineers, a SolidWorks exam.

items.title: Sparseal releases CozyBlanket Pro
items.excerpt: Sparseal's much-anticipated AI-assisted retopology, UV unwrapping and baking app CozyBlanket Pro is now available for iPad, with a desktop edition in development.

items.title: Workday launches Sana-based UI, autopilot agents, as it deepens its focus on AI
items.excerpt: Workday is replacing its interface with a Sana-based agent UI. Autonomous agents keep running while users are offline and tell them what they missed when they sign in, and customers can even go headless.

items.title: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash now available on AI Gateway
items.excerpt: Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash image generation and editing models are now callable through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key, unified billing and request traces.

items.title: Muse Wonder now available on AI Gateway
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse Wonder model can now be called through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key, no provider account, spend tracking and request traces.

items.title: Design System in Code: What It Is and How to Build One
items.excerpt: Eleken explains how a design system that lives in code compares with Figma-only systems and UI kits, and how to build one that works for designers, developers and AI tools.

items.title: AI-Native UX Design: How to Design for Systems, Not Screens
items.excerpt: Practical patterns for designing AI-native products around systems rather than screens, so they feel clear, trustworthy and easy to use.

items.title: This cool interactive visual argues that generative art began in a cave
items.excerpt: Le Random's Living Timeline maps 1,147 moments in generative art, from 71,000 BCE ochre etchings to today's AI-styled images, to explain where algorithmic and AI art come from.

items.title: Config India 2026: Figma product launch keynote (Dylan Field, CEO & Co-founder, Figma)
items.excerpt: Figma's product launch keynote, streamed live from Config India, where Dylan Field presents what's next for how teams design, build and collaborate.

items.title: New Claude Motion is Insane
items.excerpt: A hands-on look at Anthropic's Claude Motion beta, which writes code to animate text, charts, shapes and images into editable motion graphics and explainers with MP4 export.

items.title: Build teaser assets for a campaign fast using Adobe Stock's AI Studio
items.excerpt: Adobe walks through using Adobe Stock's AI Studio to quickly build a carousel of teaser assets that matches a campaign's warm, minimal look.

items.title: FAST Video Voice Dubbing in Multiple Languages with ElevenCreative
items.excerpt: DesignCourse demonstrates dubbing videos into multiple languages with ElevenLabs' ElevenCreative, framing AI as a tool that speeds up content creation rather than doing it all for you. (Sponsored by ElevenLabs.)

items.title: Figma for Edu: Working with typography systems
items.excerpt: A Figma workshop on building consistent, scalable design systems with typography, variables and modes, which work as design tokens.
